scope: Only registered deterministic error contracts in hkd/personal_reliability; source-pairing assumptions remain explicit.
new_category_policy: A newly reproduced defect must be added with stable ID, precise scope, failing regression and status open; switch to enforced only after repair. Open, missing, skipped, expected-failure or failing checks fail the monitor. Do not automatically infer novel semantic types from model text.

categories.scope: A nonempty claim must have exactly one occurrence, including overlaps.
Contradiction citations must reference an existing source and a nonempty exact quote.
A stripped quote identical to the claim cannot alone establish contradiction.
Overlapping annotations are rejected and original content/offsets preserved.
Unsupported verdicts/rewrites and citations on unverified findings are rejected.
No-findings output and model judgments never certify overall truth/completeness.
Only final agent text from one valid completed Codex JSONL turn can be reviewed.
Ordered fresh bounded evidence reads; missing sources fail.
Full canonical text/evidence/kind/implementation identity must match before reuse.
Expiry at the boundary, clock reversal and explicit fresh requests invalidate saved reviews.
Returned mutations cannot poison stored snapshots; invalid snapshots fail revalidation.
Keys and serialized payloads both count toward the entry/byte limits; clearing releases retained entries.
Failed reviews are not cached; successful hits are explicitly labeled saved, not fresh.

Exactly All tests passed. paired with one supplied outcome: 0..999999999, One, or Two test(s) failed. Positive counts are deterministically flagged even if model omits them. Other syntax is out of scope.
Paid ALU reporting retains measured arithmetic and immutable result records; paid thread edition is the included implementation.

out_of_scope: Arbitrary natural-language entailment or omissions outside the registered grammar
Truth/freshness of supplied sources and whether the caller paired the intended run
Automatic interception of hosted ChatGPT conversations
